_meta.scope: Sick Young Infant, age up to 2 months
_meta.source: IMNCI Chart Booklet for Medical Officers (2023), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of India
_meta.note: Sign definitions and thresholds paraphrased from the official chart booklet for machine-readable use. Always cross-reference the source PDF before finalizing.

feeding.description: How well the infant is feeding

convulsions.description: Whether the infant has had convulsions or is convulsing now

breathing_rate.description: Breath count per minute, and age-adjusted fast-breathing threshold
breathing_rate.note: Fast breathing threshold is 60+ breaths/min if infant is under 7 days old; also 60+ breaths/min for infants 7-59 days old per local bacterial infection check.

jaundice_onset.description: When yellow skin discoloration first appeared

jaundice_extent.description: How far the yellow discoloration has spread

diarrhoea_present.description: Whether stool pattern has changed to frequent and watery

weight_status.note: Very low weight = under 1800g if infant is under 7 days old, or weight-for-age below -3SD if 7-59 days old.

other_foods_or_drinks.description: Whether infant receives foods/drinks other than breastmilk

thrush.description: Ulcers or white patches in the mouth
